extraction.workshop_summary: The group agreed that the core product range (≈80% of SKUs) is owned by Group Category Management while each market may own up to 20% of SKUs as a local range. The local share will be reviewed after six months. Multi‑market new brand listings will be routed through a monthly Group range forum (Karin, the four commercial leads, and Henrik). Actions were assigned to develop a shared category tree, draft buyer briefings, create a RACI, and produce pricing options for the local range. Open issues remain around the exact local share per market, pricing rules for the local range, full PIM integration, timing of buyer briefings, and supplier communication.

# Evaluation run: Decision Memo  
** |  | eval-1793260075728**

## Bottom line  
The Group will own the core product range (≈80 % of SKUs) while each market may own up to 20 % as a local range, with a six‑month review. The next workshop on 4 Nov 2026 must approve pricing options for the local range and the draft RACI. The biggest risk is supplier attempts to secure better terms with individual markets before the Group range forum is operational.

## Decisions made  

| Decision | Scope | Owner |
|---|---|---|
| Group Category Management owns the core range (≈80 % of SKUs); each market commercial lead owns a local range up to 20 % per category | Group with local variant | Karin Ekström |
| Local range share will be reviewed after six months | Group | Karin Ekström |
| New brands listed in > one market must be approved by the Group range forum; single‑market listings stay local | Group with local variant | Karin Ekström |
| Group range forum will consist of Karin, the four market commercial leads, and Henrik (Pricing) and will meet monthly | Group | Karin Ekström |
| Next workshop session scheduled for 4 Nov 2026 | Group | Karin Ekström |
| Rasmus Juul will lead the technical work to create a shared category tree; Karin will convene category managers to agree the tree | Group | Rasmus Juul |
| Ole Madsen will draft the key briefing messages for buyers about the new decision rights | Group | Ole Madsen |
| Karin Ekström will own the RACI for the end‑to‑end process (listing to delisting) and will deliver a draft by 13 Nov 2026 | Group | Karin Ekström |

## Decisions requiring your sign‑off  
*None.*

## Open issues for escalation  

1. **Local SKU share per market** – Options: keep 20 % cap for all markets or allow market‑specific adjustments after review. *Recommended next step:* Escalate to Group Leadership for a decision on market‑specific caps.  
2. **Pricing methodology for the local range** – Options: full group pricing, margin floor set by group, or a hybrid approach. *Recommended next step:* Escalate to Group Pricing (Henrik Dahl) to approve the approach before the 4 Nov session.  
3. **Full PIM integration** – Options: start with a shared reporting view now or merge PIM systems next year. *Recommended next step:* Escalate to IT Leadership to confirm timeline and resources.  
4. **Buyer‑briefing draft deadline** – Options: deliver before the next workshop (4 Nov) or within two weeks of today. *Recommended next step:* Escalate to Ole Madsen to commit to the earlier deadline.  
5. **Supplier communication of centralisation plan** – Options: Group‑level communication led by Karin or market‑level communication. *Recommended next step:* Escalate to Karin Ekström to define the communication lead.

## Key risks & dependencies  

| Risk | Impact | Likelihood | Mitigation |
|---|---|---|---|
| Suppliers may lock in better terms with individual markets before the Group range forum is operational | High | Medium | Proactively inform key suppliers of the centralisation timeline (owner: Karin Ekström) |
| Delay in delivering the shared category tree could postpone implementation of the new decision rights | Medium | Medium | Assign clear ownership to Rasmus Juul and fast‑track agreement with category managers |
| Buyer anxiety could reduce morale or cause turnover | Medium | Medium | Provide clear briefing messages and involve buyers early (owner: Ole Madsen) |
